title: Successor formula for a prefix value
statement: For every Boolean sequence $f:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and natural number $i$, the weighted prefix value below $i+1$ equals the weighted prefix value below $i$ plus $(f(i))\,2^i$, where a true Boolean has value $1$ and a false Boolean has value $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean sequence indexed by natural numbers
